prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. Edit the attached Veles aerial map into a substantially MORE REALISTIC, STRICTLY VERTICAL NADIR ORTHOPHOTO with a redesigned austere functional UI. Produce one large wide 16:9 image. Preserve river outline and bends, settlement position, forest and open-ground distribution, southwest rounded ridge, paths and named location positions. Do not add settlements, bridges or landmarks.

CRITICAL CORRECTION: the reference is a miniature diorama seen at an oblique angle. Remove ALL visible sides of trees, buildings, cave entrances and cliff props. Every pixel must resemble a real orthorectified aerial photograph taken with camera pointing exactly straight down, 90 degrees to level ground, not an angled drone photo, not an isometric game render. Forest canopy must be a dense irregular fine granular aerial texture of tiny round/radially branching canopy tops, NOT rows of cone-shaped fir tree side silhouettes. Absolutely no visible trunks, triangular Christmas tree profiles or upright trees. Vary canopy size, spacing, natural gaps, muted species colors, and age. Much smaller more natural terrain texture detail. Buildings seen only as small roof rectangles, no walls, no front doors, no raised miniature models. The cave entrance at upper center-right MUST NOT show a frontal dark arch, doorway, hole or cavern mouth: REMOVE the arch entirely, replace it with overhead weathered rocky terrain and a narrow path terminating at the foot of a rock outcrop; the UI label alone indicates the hidden entrance. No invented vertical sinkhole. Real erosion, fractured stone, fine scree, irregular vegetation boundaries, riverbank sediment and gravel, authentic aerial water color. Clear neutral diffuse daylight, short soft shadows, no dramatic lighting, NO tilt shift, NO miniature effect, no shallow depth of field, uniform focus everywhere. No outlines, contours, painterly brush strokes, theatrical fantasy scenery or ornamental cartography. Preserve geographic layout but completely rebuild the too-perfect diorama surface into natural photographic ground.

REDESIGN ALL UI TYPOGRAPHY AND SYMBOLS. Strict neutral Korean sans-serif similar to Pretendard or Noto Sans KR: straight clean regular-weight text, no brush calligraphy, NO serifs, NO handwritten or italic labels, no decorative spacing, no outlined/bold bubble lettering, no fantasy flourishes. Small consistent regular/medium labels with restrained fine shadow or subtle dark backplate only where necessary. Title "벨레스 일대" modest medium weight, not large decorative heading. Small breadcrumb "이그니스 타이가". Thin opaque charcoal top bar and bottom bar, straight rectangular flat functional layout, no gold trim, no embossed or beveled surfaces, no ornamental corners.
Map labels exact: "벨레스", "금빛 안개 삼림", "테른 강", "숲 입구", "동굴 입구", "공방", "나루". All horizontal clean sans serif.
Replace large gemstone gold objective diamond with SMALL flat muted amber hollow square, single 1-pixel stroke, no nested diamond, no glow. Replace oversized cyan crystal triangle with SMALL flat pale cyan location dot and a tiny simple heading tick, no bevel or gem shape. Major places small neutral gray dots, no big hollow medallions. These symbols should be only about 6-9 pixels at 1672px image width. No decorative compass: upper-right simple small "N" with a thin straight arrow, thin close X. Bottom textual legend with these same tiny flat symbols: "현재 위치" "목적지" "주요 장소". Bottom-right plain small text "휠 확대·축소" and "Esc 닫기", no illustrated mouse or chunky keyboard button icons. UI must feel like sober professional mapping software adapted to a grounded realistic game. No science-fiction holography, radar or targeting reticles.
Prioritize top-down photographic realism and austere typography over preserving reference style. This is NOT a color correction: rebuild the projection cues and redesign all typography/icons.
